simple.summary: צָלִי (tsâlîy) means roasted First listed occurrence: Exod 12 8.

definitions.full: H6748. tsali צָלִי adjective et noun masculine roasted, roast ; — construct (as adjective) צְלִיאֵֿשׁ (P) of flesh ( בָּשָׂר ) Exod 12:8-9 , (opposed to בַּסָּ֑יִם מְבֻשָׁל ); absolute as substantive cognate Isa 44:16 see [ צָלָה ].
